[P2] Remove declaration maps left by previous builds

Building the base branch, switching to this revision, and rebuilding leaves the existing `dist-types/**/*.d.ts.map` files intact. Removing `--declarationMap` stops emission but does not delete previous output, and neither `build` nor `prepack` cleans it. The package still includes those maps, so the new `check:package` fails in an already-built checkout. Remove obsolete maps during the build or exclude them from packing, and cover rebuilding with existing maps in a regression test.
